placeholders.{done}: Count of completed habits today (boardCountLabel), completed days in the 5-week heat strip (heatLabel*, heatGroupLabel*), or completed days this week (habitModel.cadenceText.weekly*).
placeholders.{total}: Total active habits count on the Habit check-ins card header (boardCountLabel).
placeholders.{name}: User-visible habit title (habits, habitMenu, habitToasts) or event organizer name (events.explain.organizer).
placeholders.{key}: Single-digit keyboard shortcut 1-9 for the first nine active habits (habits.check*WithKey).
placeholders.{streak}: Consecutive completed due days or weeks for a habit (habits.streakLabel).
placeholders.{unit}: Localized streak unit from habitModel.units (day / days / week / weeks in en).
placeholders.{day}: Numeric month/day string formatted by shortDay() such as 11/3 (habits.heatCell*, habitToasts.day*, habitModel.cellTitle).
placeholders.{state}: Localized heat-cell state label (Done, Missed, Rest day) in habitModel.cellTitle.
placeholders.{count}: Archived habit count in habitArchive.toggle* or failing event feed count in eventServerErrors.allFeedsFailed*.
placeholders.{n}: Weekly goal count 1-6 in habitDialog.timesOption* or event group count in events.countLabel*.
placeholders.{fallback}: Auto-derived 2-4 character default short label from defaultShort(name) in habitDialog.shortHint*.
placeholders.{habit}: Habit name in the Today/Habits shared undo toast (habitToasts.todayUnchecked).
placeholders.{reason}: Underlying error message interpolated into save, action, or undo error toasts.
placeholders.{time}: 24-hour local HH:MM clock string (habitModel.cadenceText.doneAt, events.starts/lasts/today/tomorrow) or formatted sync timestamp from syncedLabel() (events.showingAt, events.staleSource, eventShared.staleShowing).
placeholders.{times}: Target check-ins per week (1-7) in habitModel.cadenceText.weekly*.
placeholders.{cadence}: Base localized cadence phrase before appending a user hint in habitModel.cadenceText.withHint.
placeholders.{hint}: Optional user cadence note (e.g. Before bed) in habitModel.cadenceText.withHint.
placeholders.{max}: Maximum active habits limit (HABIT_LIMITS.active = 30) in habitServerErrors.maxActive*.
placeholders.{origin}: Mail message description from which an AI event suggestion was extracted (events.from).
placeholders.{duration}: Localized event duration phrase from eventModel.duration (events.lasts).
placeholders.{days}: Multi-day event span in events.allDays* or days remaining until start in events.daysLeft*.
placeholders.{source}: Localized event source name (CTFtime or Event feeds) in events.staleSource.
placeholders.{title}: Event title on cards, ARIA labels, and Google/local calendar undo toasts.
placeholders.{date}: Numeric month/day string (e.g. 10/17) or combined date-block phrase (e.g. 10/17 Sat in events.cardAria).
placeholders.{place}: Resolved event venue or Online label in events.explain.place.
placeholders.{label}: Feed/source label in events.explain.source or localized action noun in eventShared.actionFailed.
placeholders.{weekday}: Localized short weekday token (Sun-Sat in en) in eventModel.monthDayWeek.

budgets.layoutNote: Verified against HabitsPage.css, HabitMenu.css, Chip.css, and EventsPage.css at 320px and 360px viewports: (1) .h-days uses grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 12px) with 5px gaps, so 1-char weekday initials (M T W T F S S, <= 9px at 12px font) center cleanly above each 12px dot with zero column collision. (2) At <= 374px, .habit moves the 114px heat strip to row 2 and hides .h-head-label; at 375-720px, 'Last 5 weeks' (12 chars, ~68px) fits inside the >= 93px main column; on > 720px desktop, 'Streak' (6 chars) and '{streak} days/weeks' fit inside the 72px streak column. (3) In HabitDialog (248px inner form width at 320px), segmented options Daily (5) + Weekdays (8) + Weekly (6) total ~224px including 14px button side padding, fitting on a single line even when all 3 options appear. (4) On EventsPage, .event-card .dblock is fixed at 48px wide (46px inner width), so dayBlockLabels use Today (5 chars, ~33px), Tmrw (4 chars, ~31px), and Sun-Sat (3 chars) to prevent overflow while .ev-when displays 'Tomorrow 08:00' in full. (5) Events filter chips All (3), Going (5), CTF (3), Community (9), and From mail (9) stay <= 9 chars each, and .ev-acts buttons Going (5), Add to Calendar (15), Skip (4), and In Calendar (11) fit cleanly inside the 196px (at 320px) / 236px (at 360px) card main column.

rationale: Preserves every shipped zh-TW string and template literal from commit 0ab616c1769bb6090bb6a7fd545b19fbe5d451f2 byte-for-byte so existing zh-TW snapshots and unit tests (HabitRow.test.ts, habits/model.test.ts, shared/habits.test.ts, events-model.test.ts) pass with zero regression.

Enforces SIGNOFF-copy-2026-11-09.md section 3 across both locales: capitalized 'Today' refers to the Today place/surface (habitDialog.shortHint*: 'on Today's check-in button', plus paired shortHint*TodayPlace keys matching todayPlaceFixes in strings.json), while calendar-date references use 'today' lowercase in sentences ('{done} of {total} completed today', 'done today') and 'Today' when leading a standalone label or phrase ('Today', 'Today {time}').

Maintains 100% cross-page glossary alignment with BELL Personal's shipped Today, Tasks, Ideas, and Suite specs: Add habit, Undo, Try again, Refresh, Settings, Going, Add to Calendar, In Calendar, Explain this, and typographic curly double quotes around user titles.

Provides paired *One and plural keys with identical placeholder tokens wherever English requires singular/plural agreement (day/days, week/weeks, 1 time/N times a week, 1 day/N days completed, In 1 day/In N days, 1 event/N events, 1 feed/All N feeds).
Eliminates all CLI/token/OAuth/API jargon, all CJK characters in en and $meta, all forbidden synonyms for Ideas, and all em-dashes across the entire file.
assumptions: Conditional functions in src/copy/habits.ts are expanded into explicit static leaf keys with 100% placeholder parity: checkLabel -> checkDoneWithKey / checkDone / checkTodoWithKey / checkTodo; autoCheckLabel -> autoCheckDone / autoCheckPending; heatCellLabel -> heatCellLabel / heatCellTodayLabel / heatCellRestLabel / heatCellTodayRestLabel; HABIT_ARCHIVE.toggle -> toggleOpenOne / toggleOpen / toggleClosedOne / toggleClosed.

habitDialog.shortHint and habitDialog.shortHintEmpty preserve the exact 0ab616c zh-TW bytes from src/copy/habits.ts lines 66-67 for strict source parity, while habitDialog.shortHintTodayPlace and habitDialog.shortHintEmptyTodayPlace provide the SIGNOFF-copy-2026-11-09.md place-name update (matching strings.json todayPlaceFixes.habitShortHint*) when PO-13 updates zh-TW.

In HabitsPage.tsx line 259, HABIT_AUTO.notConnected is rendered immediately before a space and <TextLink href='#/settings/sources'>{HABIT_AUTO.settingsLink}</TextLink>, so en.habitAuto.notConnected ends as a complete sentence followed by the standalone 'Settings' link.

Under ?lang=en, EventsPage.tsx maps server EventSourceState ids ('ctftime', 'feeds') through eventModel.sourceLabels before calling events.staleSource so stale notes never leak the server's Chinese 'feeds' label.

Inside the 48px-wide .dblock on EventCard, eventModel.dayBlockLabels.tomorrow uses 'Tmrw' (4 chars) so the label never clips horizontally, while the adjacent .ev-when badge spells out 'Tomorrow {time}' in full.
